newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia measures seen hitting economic openness.
newsitem.headline: Colombia measures seen hitting economic openness.

text.p: Emergency measures to combat Colombia's yawning fiscal deficit are a setback to a six-year drive toward greater economic openness, the head of the country's most influential financial association said Tuesday.

Armando Montenegro, chairman of the National Association of Financial Institutions (ANIF), said a tax on newly contracted foreign debt -- part of the economic emergency plan decreed Monday -- amounted to a tariff on imports, given that many of Colombia's imports are financed by foreign credit.
